title: Proof of concept: fused stages 4-7 in WGSL and a pinned LibRaw decode
outcome: WGSL kernel within 8.1e-6 of the CPU reference on nine settings sets (llvmpipe), its 1 % gain twin at 2.2e-3 or more; LibRaw decode doubles every channel mean at +1 EV on three roll #8 NEFs (ratio 2.0000).

title: Repository rules, task log and CI on macOS and Windows
outcome: CLAUDE.md with the hard and comment rules, docs/tasks.json, CI building the workspace and running the render checks; first run green on macos-latest and windows-latest.

title: Vendor LibRaw 0.22.2 and build it from source on every platform
detail: LibRaw 0.21 from the system knows no Nikon Z f: identity rgb_cam, zero cam_xyz, so roll #8 decoded as raw camera RGB.
outcome: LibRaw 0.22.2 vendored and compiled by build.rs with cc, pkg-config dropped. Z f now gets its matrix (cam_xyz non-zero); linearity test 2.0000 at +1 EV on three roll #8 frames; against the Swift decode a 3x3 fit is near-diagonal (scale about 2.7, median error 0.3 to 0.9 % on DSC_6448), so no channel swap or clipping.

title: Phone link: scanner remote over Noise, LocalSend import, phone FFI
detail: Crates oni-link, oni-localsend, oni-link-ffi and oni-link-demo for ONI Mobile; the desktop drives Host, HostEvents and publish.
outcome: Four crates, 44 tests with twins that fail when a guard is removed (stranger key, reused pairing code, revoked phone, lying sha256, wrong size, traversal, wrong pinned fingerprint), green on macOS and Windows CI. Loopback bench 0.08 ms median, 0.31 ms p99 per press. The FFI was built for iOS and linked into ONI Mobile, which launched in the iOS simulator on the reference Mac.

title: Move the vendored LibRaw version note out of the include path
detail: macOS clang found libraw/VERSION for #include <version> on a case-insensitive disk and parsed it as C++.
outcome: Note moved to crates/oni-decode/LIBRAW_VERSION; Linux build passes; macOS verified by CI on the next run.

title: Bring the ported core crates into the workspace
detail: oni-settings, oni-render (replacing the smaller one), oni-graph, oni-colour, oni-export, oni-library and the Slint proof of concept, ported from the Swift app as standalone packages.
outcome: Seven crates in crates/ (oni-settings, oni-render replacing the smaller copy it contains, oni-graph, oni-colour, oni-export, oni-library, oni-ui-poc) plus oni-fixtures; PaperCorrection kept in oni-settings only and ExifMetadata in place of oni-export's Metadata; Graph::from_device and Gpu::from_device, the shared-device check with its twin. On Linux with lavapipe: build, clippy --all-targets (0 warnings) and cargo test --release --workspace pass, 233 tests in the moved crates with roll #8, the Lumix files and the Swift dumps present; with every folder absent and ONI_SKIP_HEAVY set, as CI runs, 233 pass and 22 checks print SKIPPED, the kernels judged on a stand-in negative; with no Vulkan driver the GPU checks skip. macOS and Windows not verified here: left to the CI run of this push. oni-decode's linearity check still fails without a RAW, so CI excludes it.
